verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own help center has dedicated first-party articles titled "Scheduled Send" and "Undo send", which directly match both halves of the story. The pack contains only the article titles, though, so how scheduling works and how long the undo grace window lasts are not evidenced. missing for 10: details of scheduling options and the undo-send grace-window length and configurability, independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
